meta.title: Route 66 Logbook: Keep the Mother Road Alive
meta.description: A living map of 1,000+ Route 66 stops, kept current by the travellers driving it. Free to explore, with a logbook for every stop you visit.
hero.sub: The diners, the neon, the ghost towns — the best of Route 66 hides off the highway. Plan your route, log every stop, and share the road with people who live for it.
pain.title: Blink and you'll miss it.
pain.body: Diners close overnight. Neon goes dark. The best stops aren't on the highway, they're the ones nobody tells you about. Show up with the wrong map and you'll drive {{n.miles}} miles right past them.
pain.c1.title: Outdated information everywhere
pain.c1.text: Blog posts from 2014. Google reviews that haven't been updated since the place closed. You show up and there's nothing there.
pain.c2.title: Paper passports miss half the stops
pain.c2.text: Static, incomplete, and they don't tell you what's actually open today. Route 66 deserves better than a pamphlet.
pain.c3.title: No way to properly track your journey
pain.c3.text: You drive {{n.miles}} miles and come home with a handful of photos and no record of what you saw. Or what you missed.
sol.title:
Plan it. Drive it.
Log it. Share it.
sol.intro: Everything you need to turn {{n.miles}} miles into the trip of your life, and a community that's already driven every one of them.
f1.title: A Living Map
f1.text: 1000+ stops across all 8 states. Diners, neon signs, ghost towns, ruins, motels, and more. Updated by the community as things open, close, and change.
f2.title: Stop Detail
f2.text: Every stop has a full card with photos, hours, categories, community reports, and navigation. Tap any pin to see what's there before you pull over.
f3.title: Trip Planning
f3.text: Save what catches your eye and build your route before you go. Simply use the Favorites filter to see your bookmarked stops on the map or the list.
f4.title: Your Personal Logbook
f4.text: Automatically tracks stops as you drive past them. Confirm what you saw, add notes, earn achievements. Your Route 66 story, recorded forever.
f5.title: 60+ Achievements
f5.text: From First Sighting to Mother Road Complete. Earn badges for states crossed, categories mastered, streaks kept, and moments only this road can give you.
f6.title: Filter by Passion
f6.text: Neon hunter? Diner obsessive? Ghost town seeker? Filter the map to show only what matters to you: 11 categories, fully searchable.
f7.title: Share the Road
f7.alt: Adding a stop to the map
f7.text: Found a diner worth the detour? A ghost town nobody's logged? Add it to the map, flag what's changed, and pass it on to the traveller right behind you.
fcta.title: Ready to hit the road?
fcta.sub: Free to explore every mile. Start mapping your trip today.
ed.title: The road, documented.
com.title:
The road lives
because you do.
com.body: The best part of Route 66 was never the asphalt. It's the people who can't stop driving it. Every stop you add, every edit you suggest, every flag you raise. It keeps Route 66 documented for the next traveller behind you. This isn't a guidebook. It's a living record.
